# Requirements

Source status: Synthetic Batch 39 M17 fixture.

## Scope

- Model a local orders schema migration contract.
- Record approval boundaries for production access and migration execution.
- Prove that static fixture checks can validate no live database action was performed.

## Non-Goals

- No production data access.

- No release or readiness claim.
